difficulty.infoText: Controls how many missions are generated per day. Takes effect at the next daily reset or regeneration.

easy.label: EASY
easy.desc1: · Ideal for starting out or tough days

custom.label: CUSTOM
custom.desc0: · Choose how many daily missions you want
custom.desc1: · Ideal for adjusting volume to your schedule

intensity.infoText: Sets the severity of penalties when failing daily missions. Punishment is calculated based on the number of failed missions.

custom.label: CUSTOM
custom.desc0: · Set how many hours of blocking you want

autoBlock.cardDesc: If enabled, failing daily missions will automatically block your selected apps. Time varies with difficulty:
autoBlock.toggleSub: Otherwise, only XP and Gold will be deducted.

sideQuestPenalty.infoText: Daily tasks are a personal notepad — no rewards, cleared at midnight. Enable this option so incomplete tasks count as failures in the daily penalty.
sideQuestPenalty.rowSubActive: [ ACTIVE — pending tasks add to failures ]
sideQuestPenalty.rowSubInactive: Inactive — tasks have no impact on punishments

theme.infoText: Select the visual theme for your Monarch System. New themes are unlocked by ranking up or in the Shop.

backup.infoText: Export or restore your Shadow Monarch journey by copying an inviolable code.

importModal.title: IMPORT SOUL
importModal.subtitle: Paste your Base64 code below to overwrite the current database.

restDay.infoText: Enable to declare today as a Rest Day. Missions appear dimmed and there will be no punishments at tomorrow's reset. Automatically disables at end of day.
